question: Should CodexBar display Neuralwatt's active subscription kWh allowance alongside prepaid USD credits, or intentionally define Neuralwatt as a prepaid-balance-only provider?
rationale: Both quota pools represent independently usable service, but displaying them introduces mixed units and an additional usage lane; accepting balance-only semantics can instead show an exhausted state while subscription capacity remains.

options.title: Display both quota pools
options.body: Show prepaid USD credits and active subscription kWh as separate, clearly labeled metrics so the menu reflects all remaining usable capacity.

options.title: Accept balance-only semantics
options.body: Keep the current UI but explicitly define and communicate that it reports only prepaid credits and does not represent subscription availability.

recommendation.title: Display both quota pools
recommendation.body: Show prepaid USD credits and active subscription kWh as separate, clearly labeled metrics so the menu reflects all remaining usable capacity.
